description: This file declares utility functions and constants related to metrics and analytics within the 'metrics' namespace, including functions to retrieve system information, generate session IDs, and send metrics data.

methods.name: GetOsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operating system.

methods.name: GetOsVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the operating system.

methods.name: GenerateSessionId
methods.description: Generates a session ID based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: GetMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: GetCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the device.

methods.name: GetVmmVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the Virtual Machine Monitor.

methods.name: GetEpochTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the current epoch time in milliseconds.

methods.name: ProtoToString
methods.description: Converts a LogEvent protocol buffer message to its string representation.

methods.name: PostRequest
methods.description: Posts metrics data to the specified Clearcut server instance.
